titleText: JTF News: Deutsche Welle, The Guardian
mainText: The United States plans an evacuation flight for American cruise passengers affected by hantavirus.

titleText: JTF News: The Guardian, BBC News
mainText: The UK government reports a third British national has a suspected hantavirus infection.
The Pentagon released classified files related to unidentified flying objects.
President Trump stated that Russia and Ukraine are to observe a three-day ceasefire.

titleText: JTF News: PBS NewsHour, UN News
mainText: The United Arab Emirates reports an Iranian drone and missile attack; the United States reports exchanging fire with Iran.
